description: Pasted the slip and named the offence against nature.
name: Abel Garnish

description: Heard. He was not given a rival copy.
name: Humphrey Larkham

description: Counted the slip as one, and sent you toward the table.
name: John Heminges

description: Refused a second size, and told Garnish to paste before a beauty returned.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Heard the new end and took the next miss on himself.
name: Richard Cowley

description: Ordered the paste and gave the cheapness as the reason.
name: William Shakespeare
